name: wan2gp-minipaint-bridge
description: Lets the a1111-mini-paint-NEO extension ask this WanGP what image inputs it can accept right now, hand it one PNG at a time, and add the live page - with a prompt or images overridden for that one request - to WanGP's own queue, starting the run through WanGP's own generate trigger when WanGP is idle and joining the running one otherwise, and report where the tasks a page admitted are in WanGP's queue. Adds no generation UI, never presses Generate while a generation is running, and changes no generation behaviour. Also answers an authenticated loopback control surface so the extension can compose, submit, follow and cancel a generation with no page open, and can commit the live settings form on request so a job queued from another tab runs at what was on screen.
author: a1111-mini-paint-NEO

compatibility.note: The version range is an early filter only. Real compatibility is functional: the bridge resolves its components through the plugin API and reports ready=false with BRIDGE_COMPONENT_INCOMPATIBLE when a mandatory one is missing.
